description:
Tencent Cloud CLS observability SDK for AgentScope Java (v2), enhanced.
        Ships its own ClsTracingMiddleware that captures the fields the stock
        OtelTracingMiddleware omits — session.id / user.id, tool arguments,
        streamed tool results, and reasoning thoughts — and exports OpenTelemetry
        spans to Tencent Cloud CLS via the standard OTLP/HTTP protocol.
